what: Seller tested prompts by running them through ChatGPT and Claude, adjusting the wording, improving the structure, and verifying each produced useful output. Describes this testing/refinement step as the most time-consuming part of production. Grouped prompts into categories — content creation, sales and marketing, productivity, business operations — and organized them in a PDF and Google Doc. Product named "Scaling AI Prompt Pack." Seller states total cost to create was $0 and total time was approximately 8–10 hours. Product built over three evenings.
verbatim_snippet: "I spent time actually testing prompts — not just writing them, but running them through ChatGPT and Claude, adjusting the wording, improving the structure, and making sure each one produced something genuinely useful. This part took the longest. But it's what made the product worth buying."
